assets.name: background
assets.description: The backdrop the cartridges sit on. Wordless, so one drawing serves every locale. The eventual look is an '80s kid's room (see #104); today it is whatever fills the screen behind a grid of cartridges. Placeholder wash via tools/gen_hub_placeholders.py.

assets.name: cartridge_boil
assets.description: The cartridge shell, one drawing shared by every adventure: a hole 180x120 at (20,22) shows that adventure's icon through it, so the hole must be fully transparent. Drawn light and neutral — the per-adventure colour is applied by multiplying the texture, and a dark body swallows the tint. Drawn once and traced twice more; the three frames cycling are the boil that says it is tappable.

assets.name: gear_boil
assets.description: The settings button in the corner of the selection screen — a whole button, glyph and background in one image, wordless like everything the audience sees. Drawn once and traced twice more for the boil.

assets.name: help_boil
assets.description: The about/help button beside the gear, for a grown-up wanting to know what the app is. Same treatment as the gear.

assets.name: exit_boil
assets.description: The quit button, third in the corner row. The selection screen is the one place the game is left from, so this is the only exit.

assets.name: hub_button
assets.description: The corner button that leaves an adventure, drawn over every scene. 64px square, above Apple's 44pt minimum, because a two-year-old aims it. The one tappable thing in the game that does NOT boil: it sits over a scene whose own hotspots are boiling to say 'tap me', and a wobble in the corner would pull the eye off them — leaving is not what we want to advertise. Quiet chrome, so it should read as an overlay rather than as part of the scene. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_panel
assets.description: The panel the leave-the-adventure question sits on, drawn behind the two answers. One picture, so drawn art can change the card's shape, colour and framing — the engine only knows where it goes. Not tappable, so it does not boil. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_yes_boil
assets.description: The 'yes, leave the adventure' button on the confirmation the back-to-hub button raises. A whole button — background and glyph in one image — and wordless, since the audience cannot read. Drawn once and traced twice more: the three frames cycling are the boil that says it is tappable. Belongs to the engine, so every adventure shows the same one. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_no_boil
assets.description: The 'no, stay here' button on the same confirmation, and the one a stray tap should land on. Drawn once and traced twice more, like the yes button. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.
